title: Basic Electrical Skills
shortDescription: Learn safe habits, essential tools and the basics of household electrical work.
description: Build a practical foundation in electrical safety, common tools, simple circuits and basic fault finding. This course is for new learners and focuses on understanding the work and knowing when a qualified electrician is needed.
objectives: Identify common electrical tools and their uses
Follow safe isolation and testing steps
Recognize faults that require a qualified electrician

modules.title: Safety and preparation
modules.summary: Set up work safely and understand the limits of basic maintenance.

lessons.title: Electrical safety comes first
lessons.description: Learn about electrical hazards, safe working areas and why power must be isolated before inspection.

lessons.title: Protective equipment and safe checks
lessons.description: Review insulated tools, protective equipment and simple checks before beginning a task.

modules.title: Tools and basic circuits
modules.summary: Recognize everyday tools and understand how a simple circuit works.

lessons.title: Common electrician hand tools
lessons.description: Identify screwdrivers, pliers, wire strippers and testers and learn where each tool is used.

lessons.title: A simple circuit explained
lessons.description: Explore the role of a source, conductor, switch and load in a basic electrical circuit.

modules.title: Inspection and maintenance
modules.summary: Practice visual inspection and know when to stop and seek qualified help.

lessons.title: Visual inspection of cables and fittings
lessons.description: Spot visible damage, loose fittings and warning signs without opening energized equipment.

lessons.title: When to call a qualified electrician
lessons.description: Learn which faults are outside basic maintenance and how to communicate them clearly.
